Overview

Puebla is a city in Puebla with a population of 3,344,756. Colonial gem with stunning architecture, UNESCO-listed cathedral, and a rich culinary tradition. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
